parameters.query:
SELECT
  EXISTS(
    SELECT 1
    FROM documents
    WHERE drive_file_id = $1
  ) AS exists_in_db,
  (
    SELECT version
    FROM documents
    WHERE drive_file_id = $1
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS db_version;

INSERT INTO document_chunks (
  document_id,
  chunk_text,
  chunk_index,
  embedding
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::vector);

SELECT
  dc.chunk_text,
  d.file_name,
  d.date_created,
  d.drive_file_id,
  d.source_url,
  1 - (dc.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity
FROM document_chunks dc
JOIN documents d ON d.id = dc.document_id
WHERE 1 - (dc.embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.5
ORDER BY dc.embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT 400;

INSERT INTO public.conversations (
  telegram_user_id,
  question,
  answer,
  sources,
  created_at
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, NOW());
